title: The software factory around the agents
subtitle: How the harness builds a domain

slides.heading: The factory
slides.narration: This is the harness that builds the product. One minute walks one unit of work from an intent to merged code, with no human in the loop.

slides.heading: Inception: intent to units
slides.narration: Inception turns an intent into units of work. One OpenSpec change holds the proposal, the design, and the spec delta, and its task list is the work, one unit per line.

slides.heading: The proposal gates the code
slides.narration: The proposal merges to main before any code. Review agents attack it, and the strict validator holds the spec text to one rule set. Only then does implementation start.

elements.label: mutation score on the new code

slides.heading: Construction: one unit flow
bullets: A brief, a test first, the code
slides.narration: Construction runs one flow per unit. The agent extracts a brief, writes the test first, writes the smallest code, and passes the gates: coverage, complexity, and mutation. One atomic commit lands per unit.

slides.heading: The review before the merge
bullets: A reviewer agent reads the whole diff
The fixes land before the merge
slides.narration: Before a merge, a reviewer agent reads the whole diff and attacks it. Each finding gets a verification against the code, and the fixes land on the branch first.

slides.heading: Observability: the run explains itself
bullets: The log hook records every call
A ledger keeps each unit's proof
A handover issue carries the telemetry
slides.narration: The run explains itself. A hook logs every tool call, a ledger keeps each unit's proof, and every handover issue carries the redacted telemetry of the run.
